name: manual_b4a1ea
claim: A strict read-only audit must not run the stock reanchor_scan.sh unchanged: it runs git fetch --prune origin, which updates and prunes remote-tracking refs. Run a no-fetch copy and prove nothing moved with a before and after ref snapshot.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-23: a no-fetch copy of the scan was used and 117 Perpetua-Tools refs and 179 orama-system refs were identical before and after.

rationale: 2026-10-23: a no-fetch copy of the scan was used and 117 Perpetua-Tools refs and 179 orama-system refs were identical before and after.
